bug_semantics: A signed user TA can set TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT in its ta_head.flags even though that flag is documented as pseudo-TA only. The user-TA loader accepts any bits in TA_FLAGS_MASK and copies them onto the shared tee_ta_ctx. tee_ta_try_set_busy() then returns immediately without taking the busy lock, so two sessions of a single-instance multi-session user TA run concurrently on one context. Both sessions map and unmap memref parameters against the same uctx->vm_info.regions list with no lock, corrupting the list and freeing vm_region nodes still in use: a use-after-free in S-EL1.
flaw_origin: In April 2018, commit 387b0ee39b1b8d5a8a0db68a0a4535d2d621342d replaced the user-TA loader's explicit optional_flags whitelist (which omitted TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT) with TA_FLAGS_MASK GENMASK_32(8,2). That contiguous mask includes bit 8, the PTA-only CONCURRENT flag, so a user TA header that sets it is no longer rejected and the existing skip-lock path in tee_ta_try_set_busy() becomes reachable on a shared user-TA context.

First-party fix and mechanism: OP-TEE/optee_os#7900 and commit 8794043c4065c26a2b8b1313794ba5ba5f06d296 (Shahriyar Jalayeri, merged 2026-08-06) add an explicit reject of TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT in core/kernel/ldelf_loader.c and ldelf/ta_elf.c. PR/commit text: flag sits inside TA_FLAGS_MASK so a user TA can set it; tee_ta_try_set_busy() skips serialization; concurrent memref map/unmap corrupts uctx->vm_info.regions and frees live vm_region nodes.

Named Fixes: tag c7c4b6e31b3ba5b1c92a50fc00680fc07755e4ef (2017-11-14, Jens Wiklander) introduced TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT (bit 8, comment 'pseudo-TAs only') and the skip-lock in tee_ta_try_set_busy()/tee_ta_clear_busy(). That commit is not the BIC: at its parent and until 387b0ee39, ta_load() still used optional_flags = USER_MODE|EXEC_DDR|SINGLE_INSTANCE|MULTI_SESSION|SECURE_DATA_PATH|INSTANCE_KEEP_ALIVE|CACHE_MAINTENANCE, so (ta_head->flags & optional_flags) != ta_head->flags rejected CONCURRENT for user TAs.

BIC 387b0ee39b1b8d5a8a0db68a0a4535d2d621342d (author Etienne Carriere, 2018-04-05) first wrote #define TA_FLAGS_MASK GENMASK_32(8,2) in lib/libutee/include/user_ta_header.h and replaced the whitelist with if (ta_head->flags & ~TA_FLAGS_MASK) in core/arch/arm/kernel/user_ta.c ta_load(), then utc->ctx.flags = ta_head->flags. GENMASK_32(h,l) is inclusive; GENMASK_32(8,2) includes bit 8 (TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT). Single parent, not a merge. git log -S TA_FLAGS_MASK -- lib/libutee/include/user_ta_header.h starts at this commit.

Parent-tree verification at 027f050651f1729eac3c50ecd8e8d3941463bf51: user_ta_header.h has TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT but no TA_FLAGS_MASK; user_ta.c still uses the optional_flags whitelist that omits CONCURRENT. Immediate parent therefore cannot accept a user TA with the concurrent bit. At the BIC, skip-lock already existed in tee_ta_manager.c and utc->vm_info->regions / tee_mmu_map_param already existed, so the UAF race is reachable as soon as the mask allows the flag.

Later loader rewrites are moves/refactors of the same check, not a new BIC: 7509ff7ce5e5a7679319e6fa059b71dd6f6cc8b9 and d1911a85142da16fef5ebdcdac0348d29ce37cd8 copied if (flags & ~TA_FLAGS_MASK) into ldelf/ta_elf.c and the kernel ldelf path; 486d6e395e6146bba6d45838e59a737494819ba4 moved it to ldelf_loader.c. Later TA_FLAGS_MASK expansions (GENMASK_32(10,0) through GENMASK_32(13,0)) still include bit 8.

reasoning: CVE-2026-71968 is a published, non-withdrawn use-after-free: a signed user TA that sets TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT is loaded, the busy lock is skipped, and concurrent memref mapping tears down uctx->vm_info.regions in S-EL1. The 2026 fix (8794043) rejects that flag for user TAs in ldelf and the kernel loader; it does not change the PTA skip-lock. The Fixes: tag names c7c4b6e, which first wrote the PTA-only flag and skip-lock, but user TAs still could not set the bit while ta_load() used an explicit optional_flags whitelist. The smallest commit that first wrote the vulnerable acceptance is 387b0ee39: it introduced TA_FLAGS_MASK as GENMASK_32(8,2), covering the PTA-only bit, and switched the loader to that mask. Direct parent 027f05065 still has the whitelist and no TA_FLAGS_MASK, so the hole is absent at the parent tree. Subsequent ldelf extraction copies the same mask check and is a refactor, not a new first-write. The BIC is a 2018 human Linaro commit with no commit-object AI marker, so the verdict is NOT_AI.
